note: Bottomland woods and old fields along Weaubleau Creek south-east of Osceola, with two primitive camping spots beside gravel lots, each at the end of its own gravel lane off SE 200: the larger lot at the Creek Access on the west side, and a small lot by the slough on the east side. No amenities. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: page 'Designated Camping Sites', Rule 140 standard; brochure 'Camping is permitted only in designated areas'; map two Primitive Camping symbols, each beside a lot - Creek Access (GIS 531 = stored pin, in open grass 32 m S of a large gravel lot) and the slough lot (GIS 530, 790 m SE). Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights now manual. Not waterfront kept. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION: area page 'Things to Do When You Visit: Camping: Designated Camping Sites'; Rule 140 standard, no special-use-permit-only rule, no Rule 101; brochure: 'Camping is permitted only in designated areas and is limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period'; 'Horseback riding is not permitted.' Map: two Primitive Camping symbols, each beside a parking lot - (1) the 'Creek Access' lot at the end of a gravel lane north from SE 200 on the west side; (2) a lot at the end of a short lane north from SE 200 by the slough on the east side. Imagery (leaf-off): (1) a gravel lot about 55 x 20 m with two vehicles on it, GIS camping point 531 in open grass 32 m south of it; (2) a small gravel turnaround about 12 x 20 m beside a grassy clearing with GIS point 530 in it. Designated points at both lots, so it stays; a 23-ft rig fits lot (1) easily, lot (2) is tight to turn.
PIN: stored 37.99459,-93.61200 = GIS 531, in grass beside the larger lot; fine, or 37.99488,-93.61195 (lot 1633) to put it on the gravel. It's the better of the two camps.
CLUSTERS: two lot-side camps 790 m apart, each on its own short lane off SE 200; too small and close for a split. near.py finds no other entry within 3 km.
HORSES: brochure 'Horseback riding is not permitted.'
WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): the Creek Access lot is about 120 m from Weaubleau Creek through woods (scaled from the map); the east lot is about 100 m from the slough. No open apron at either.
PHONE: area page '(417) 853-4592' matches stored (the brochure's local contact is the Clinton office, 660-885-6981).
Season (manual, year-round) left as stored. The 2027 MDC permit is in the policy row and isn't written per entry.
